summary.text: Kristin Phillips-Hill is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 28 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. She previously served in the state House representing District 93.

paragraphs.text: Kristin Phillips-Hill earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in public policy from Rutgers University, according to Ballotpedia.
Her professional experience includes working as a legislative aide and as the former owner of a small business.
Phillips-Hill represented District 93 in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2015 to 2018 before taking office in the state Senate on December 1, 2018.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her committees as Communications and Technology (vice chair), Appropriations, Banking and Insurance, Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, and State Government.
